content.text:
**Finding: compliant** (§ 9.4 / p0039) — no redline proposed.

§ 9.4 hits our preferred position on all material terms:
- **Customer convenience right** — 30 days' written notice, whole or in part, Agreement or any Order Form.
- **Refund** — Vendor must refund prepaid Fees allocable to the post-termination period; Customer owes fees only through the effective date.
- **No penalty** — no early-termination fee or other exit charge.
- **No Vendor mirror right** — Vendor expressly has no convenience-termination right during a committed term.

Noted in the rationale but deliberately not flagged under this rule: the take-or-pay language in § 2.1 ("without reduction or termination rights") is in tension with § 9.4 and should be reconciled under the minimum-commitment rule, to avoid double-flagging the same commercial term. The precedence ladder in § 2.2 and the cumulative-remedies sentence in § 9.5 support reading § 9.4 as operative in the meantime.
